MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 6 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 16
   C. 6
   D. 11

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 17
   D. 27

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

6. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 24

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

8. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

10. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

11. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 12.5
   D. 6

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

13. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 13
   C. 5
   D. 36

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 30
   C. 18
   D. 45

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

17. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 8
   D. 0

18. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

20. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

21. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 1

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 33
   C. 28
   D. 14

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 81

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

25. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

26. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

27. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

28. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 29

29. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

30. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 170

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
